The two vets I saw were very considerate though a bit swift to recommend taking my pet to a hospital. The way they deliver my  test results are faulty. Be prepared to ask for them. it helps to be somewhat literate in physiology and basics when reading the testing. But the vets I saw were very knowledgeable. Professional. Caring. Be prepared if you take a taxi there, you’ll have to park across the street. There is no way to pull up to the doors because of a bike lane barrier. The waiting area is large and clean. The tech staff nice. They vets also seemed wary of being hypothetical. As if the client would sue them if they answered something hypothetically. But, I get it. All in all I would recommend them. Robert at the desk was calming and helpful. The other young person that I met was helpful but she shouldn’t announce how much people owe when clients are sitting adjacent with other clients. That should be an at the desk convo with the pet owner. Other than that that she was totally fine. I wish the portal worked. It doesn’t. You must add the records yourself. One medication I got was overpriced based on the cost I saw on Chewy. There shouldn’t be any music playing in the waiting area. It’s annoying and causes stress.

Dr. Lucy was fantastic, and all of the veterinary technicians were compassionate, attentive, and reassuring. What could have been an overwhelming experience for both my dog and me was made warm and pleasant because of this incredible team. Thank you all for taking such great care of us!
Love the customer service, Robert at the receptionist desk was really welcoming and helpful, and made mine and my cats experience wonderful.
Robert really came in clutch and he helped me so much when checking out. He really cares about the clients that come here and you guys should really check out that location.
Robert was absolutely amazing and this whole team was so kind and gentle with my girl
Aweskmeexleeience would recommend to every pet parent,

10out of 10 service. I would highly recommend this cobble hill Bond vet location.
Love this clinic! Robert from the front desk staff is incredibly kind and the vets (Dr. Bloomfield and Yasmine) were very knowledgeable and took great care of Brie (our cat)
Great staff, very friendly and professional. Shout out rob!!!

Bond vet has gone significantly downhill since being acquired by private equity. They failed to diagnose our pittie with terminal stomach cancer, something that was quickly caught when we moved to another vet. They botched a TPLO surgery for our other dog and he’s in constant pain and now needs to have the plate removed. This is costing us thousands of dollars MORE and he’s still in pain.

The only way to get their attention is to pay $150/mo for a membership fee to get our dog’s pain meds in a timely manner. Do NOT go here. Go to a local vet like Seaport or Blue Pearl instead.

Oh and their AI voice assistant sucks. Just repeat “talk to a human” until you can break through.

Bond Vet always takes great care of our pup and Robert at the front desk does a great job of managing anxious pets and their owners.

Thank you!

We started bringing our senior dog to this clinic for routine appointments and vaccinations since it’s conveniently located nearby after our move. During a recent checkup, they told us she had a heart murmur and referred us to a cardiologist. At almost 13 years old, and after many checkups with different vets in the past, she had never been diagnosed with any heart issues or symptoms. Naturally, as the companion of an older dog, I promptly followed through with the specialist recommendation. After spending over $1,000, we found out she has a perfectly healthy heart; the cardiologist explained she just gets anxious and pants a lot at the vet.

While I understand the caution, I wish the doctor had taken her history and anxiety into greater consideration before recommending such an expensive assessment. Overall, the clinic is good for routine care, but I’d advise others to consider second opinions for more complex concerns, especially if your dog has anxiety.
Saw quickly and treated well!

Robert was great! Very kind and all the staff was nice and treated my Chopper amazingly!
It’s so sweet to find a place that treats your dog just like you would!
Robert was amazing!! He was very helpful and very informative. Nala enjoyed her visit and left with some delicious treats!

I love Bond Vet; more importantly, my dog loves Bond Vet. The staff there is wonderful. Robert at the front desk gets us check in and quickly checked out. All the vet techs are so capable and friendly. Phoebe is in for a lot of nurse appointments, and they never disappoint. I feel like they love Phoebe as much as I do. I know she’s in good hands with Dr. Kaufman; she always gives me honest information. I respect her opinion so much. Dr. Bloomfield gave great feedback when I asked how I could improve Phoebe’s health. Her quality of life was a top priority for him.

Dr. Bloomfield & Robert are kind, professional, and very attentive, and they made both me and my pet feel comfortable right away. The space was clean, calm, and well-organized, and the whole visit felt efficient without ever feeling rushed. Robert is great!
Robert at the front desk is so amazing along with Ty. The doctor and her assistant handled my dog with care.

Always a nice experience at this office! Rob greeted me and my dog warmly and all the vet techs we've seen have always been super great with my dog. She loves the treats in the lobby! Highly recommend the convenience and service of this spot.
Friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Very good vet

I was switching to this vet bc they caught a cancer diagnosis my old vet didn’t, but there were major issues when I tried to transfer all his meds.  He had been on a Xanax prescription for severe anxiety and after he had surgery to remove some of the cancer, the new vet at bond said they wanted me to have the oncologist play the refill of the Xanax before they approved it.  The oncologist sent them the approval and they still wouldn’t fill it which was confusing bc that was their own stipulation.  When I tried to explain this, a vet I never even met freaked out and said she placed a note on my dog’s file to never write a Xanax prescription for him.  It was a bit shocking lol.  Idk if they thought I was medication seeking thru my dog but it was weird and rude.

Came in for our cat Milo, Dr. Mackey, the nursing assistants, and Robert. All really nice and extremely helpful and did the best they could to help my pet. And even gave me medication to help him and gave me recommendations for some other help. Thank you guys.
The staff was extremely friendly, patient and knowledgeable. Robert at the front desk was the best!

5/5. Very receptive and caring staff at Cobble Hill. Thank you!

Thank you
It's over priced, long wait and hard to get hold of Dr

Dr. Daniel Bloomfield caused my senior frail cat unnecessary distress, exhaustion and disorientation.
He harmed her by treating her for a symptom that was-not-my chief complaint, was not anywhere at the top of my very pressing and clearly expressed concerns.

Dr. Bloomfield gave my cat an injection today for a symptom that was not even present,

despite the fact that I texted, emailed, and verbalized my chief complaint & worrisome concerns to both to Bond Vet and directly to Dr. Bloomfield.

My little cat is experiencing GI sensitivity.

Over the past 2 days she's come very close to not-eating-at-all-for-24-hours, is sleeping a bit more than usual and is showing a near total DISINTEREST in eating.

My little Missy is less than 5 pounds.
She's very tiny & adorable, but also very frail (experiencing weight lost and near her complete limits).
I was told by Dr. Bloomfield (and confirmed by his assistant) that Cerenia was an appetite inducing stimulant (and if it worked as hoped), would last for 24 hours.

Seeing the lethargic, disoriented condition of Little Missy, I Googled Cerenia.
It is NOT an appetite stimulant, it's PAINFUL (upon injection), causes LETHARGY and Disorientation.

Why did my little Missy need this?

Let alone Dr. Daniel Bloomfield did not handle Little Missy's body with compassion and respect; treated her tail like it was a handle (literally tugged on her tail) during the exam to get a look at her tush; not aggressively, yet, absolutely-not-gently.

His "consult" was very fatalistic, he ignored my concerns, ignored my cat's smaller symptoms that -are- treatable to improve the quality of her life & instead was hyper-focused on her senior age.

Both his dismissive and inattentive behavior during the consult and the Cerenia shot were harmful.

Dr. Bloomfield caused Missy distress, sedation and disorientation. He worsened the very symptoms we came to him to address (with an extra "side" of disorientation that Missy did-not-have prior to his "treatment").
Robert is the VERY BEST!!!!!! HE'S SO NICE AND HELPFUL!!! HES WAS THERE WHEN OUR OTHER DOG GOT SICK AND THE LEVEL OF COMPASSION WAS TOP TIER. LOVE YOU ROBERT!!!!

Normally, I love Bond Vet. This location, however, has a receptionist who is incredibly unkind. I came in with my dog this afternoon for an emergency, and he turned us away. I expressed confusion seeing as how Bond is not just a vet, but an urgent care, and I’ve been able to walk in for emergencies at plenty of other Bond locations (particularly in Murray Hill and Upper East side - the folks and service at those locations are fantastic!). The receptionist told me that it was not an urgent care, that I could find some animal ERs a few miles away, and told me I was crazy! He was incredibly disrespectful and made a stressful situation even more stressful. The actual vets at this location have been okay in the past, but seeing as how this is the second time in a year that I’ve had a negative experience with the receptionists here (the first time I was given misinformation and overcharged), I would never recommend this location to pet owners.
Staff were incredibly friendly and genuinely kind to my dog...

Cobble Hill Vet is amazing! The vets were super caring and attentive. Robert and Alegria were super helpful walking me through everything at the front desk. I highly recommend this Bond Vet for your pet!

My dog has been a patient here since i moved into the neighborhood. This is. wonderful, caring and competent clinic. Every staff member and Vet is skilled and kind. They did a teeth cleaning that I delayed scheduling because i was nervous about the procedure. I'm so glad I did because  Dr. Mackey and Lexi were excellent! Now he has fresh clean teeth.
Love love Bond vet!!! Thank you Robert for everything! We love bond vet they are very generous, gentle and kind with my fur baby!

We are so at ease with their honesty and transparency with all examinations/meds etc;  the entire staff are warm and friendly and Robert was so welcoming and helpful in walking us through membership set-up. We instantly felt like extended family.

Can’t say enough good things about this vet! From the friendliness of the front desk (especially Robert), to the care of the nurses and exceptional doctors (We see Dr Kaufman, who remembers us every time), even my finicky, vet-fearing cat has a wonderful experience here. Thank you, Bond Vet!

Issues I had in the last few months:
- Expired vaccine was administered to a puppy (Honey, standard poodle), putting her at risk of illness.
- Staff (vet tech, reception) was extremely rude when I came with a puppy (Teddy, mini poodle) with potential injury (as if I was interrupting them), it was not a walk-in, but booked visit!
- Blood tests were not done for Charlie (whoodle girl) and I got informed about this after days of waiting. She was assessed as "perfect health", and passed away about a month later in AMC hospital due to kidney failure.

Sure, you can get a visit easily (app) and quickly (not much wait), but even for routine procedures I had a terrible experience. Yet another business enshittified by VC.

I recommend going to any small local vet, or directly or ER (VERG in Brooklyn is good, AMC in Manhattan is the most capable) in case of serious issues.
Robert was an amazing help throughout our whole process and treated us with excellent care!!

My previous experience here makes sense! They are private equity backed of course they will just try to squeeze money out of you! Stay away and support independent vets.

—-

friendly staff, the vet tech and vet were both so nice with my cat. easy check in process and appt booking. I am leaving three stars because although everything is lovely the amount of upselling that they do for unnecessary things is appalling.

I would like to go to the vet, worried about my sick pet without having to think of ways to fend off the added unnecessary treatments.

They prescribed meds that didn’t treat any of my cat’s symptoms or solve his issues, they are for anxiety and pain, but my cat was not anxious and it was not determined whether anything was causing pain. They also recommended and performed subcutaneous i/v fluids. But now, looking over his records from the visit I see that the vet noted that he was not dehydrated, and I even told her he was drinking fluids like normal and I was feeding him “soups” at home which were keeping him properly hydrated. At the end they also tried to charge an extra $25 to send one of the tests to an external lab, even though the vet had already assured us that she wasn’t concerned about it, and in his records it stated that they had performed the test in house and it was normal!!!

the ease, the pretty, clean interiors, and the staff are not worth it when you have to be prepared to scrutinize every recommendation and think to yourself :

does my pet need this? Do they have sound basis for providing this? Will this actually treat any of my pet’s symptoms or illnesses? Because for half of the prescribed treatment, this was not true for me.
We've been bringing our fur babies here for the past few years. They are decently priced and they all have a great bedside manner with our cats.

And she has had a wellness check from Dr. Kaufman who gave Piper all the hugs! Today we saw Dr. Mackey and oh. my. goodness. What a lovely woman. She answered every question (and I had a TON) thoroughly and with love. How lucky are we to have found a reliable local vet. Billing is seamless. Do your pet a favor and bring them to Bond Vet for their healthcare.

The booking process was easy with lots of options for availability. The environment was nice and quiet for my highly anxious cat.
Great customer service .

Robert and team were incredible! Super knowledgeable and made this first time puppy parent feel super comfortable. Can’t recommend them enough
Finally a great vet. It’s nice to find one that’s not a crook these days. Go here.
Robert & Dr Dan are great!
This is officially my new vet. Had amazing service, the doctor was super friendly and knowledgeable and Rob at the front desk was awesome, friendly and super professional. A definite recommend.

Let me start by saying I was extremely nervous bringing my little Zsa Zsa in for her appointment at Bond Vet – Cobble Hill. That anxiety disappeared the moment I walked in. Lexy greeted me with such calm and reassurance that I immediately felt like my dog was in the right hands.

Dr. Mackey handled the dental surgery and was outstanding; very thorough, communicative, and genuinely caring. She took the time to explain everything clearly, from the procedure itself to what I should expect moving forward, which made a stressful situation much easier to navigate. She even came out and spoke to me personally. That is 5 stars alone.

And I have to give a huge shoutout to Robert, who truly brought the whole experience home. He was incredible at checkout; professional, patient, and incredibly kind. He walked me through the costs clearly, answered every single question without hesitation, and made sure I left feeling informed and supported. Robert is the kind of person who turns a good experience into a great one.

Overall, the entire team made a nerve-wracking day feel manageable, and I’m genuinely grateful for the care they gave both me and Zsa Zsa.
Love this location, Robert at the front desk is so helpful and the whole team is very patient with my puppy!
Robert was extremely helpful during the check out process and ensured all my questions were answered, thank you so much to everyone at cobble hill who took care of my baby today

Robert was incredibly helpful and a very laid-back person. I love him. The service here was exceptional, and I was delighted to see my dog receive so much love and compliments. I feel great coming here, and I’m excited to continue with Bond Vet, the top vet in my opinion!
First time and they took care of our complicated cat so well! Robert at the front desk was especially nice and helpful while I waited with my toddler.

Great experience!! We has to visit due to a dog attack. Staff was so friendly from the front desk to doctors. My dog son got the best care.
Bond vet has been my vet for 2 years and I trust them wholly with my cat. Dr Kaufman is the best and the whole scheduling process is super easy with the app.

I had a wonderful experience at Bond Vet. The entire team was incredibly kind and attentive to my cat, Parker, making us feel comfortable from the moment we walked in.

A special shout-out to Robert at the front desk he was professional, welcoming, and made the check-in and out process seamless. It’s clear the staff here truly cares about their patients. Highly recommend!
Very communicative during my cats dental extraction, answered any and all questions and followed up afterwards to check on how my cat was doing! Thank you Dr. Mackey and Lexy!
The entire experience was excellent. Extremely professional and knowledgeable staff, you can tell the vet really cares about your pets health.

My experience at Bond Vet Cobble Hill was wonderful! The doctors and staff are so kind. My cats had a great visit and received great care!

Bond has been my cat’s (Mady) primary vet for a few years now. The staff, especially at the Cobble Hill location handles my aging buddy with such care. While she’s usually nervous (and sometimes feisty) during appointments, the Bond staff handles her as if she was their pet. We appreciate them immensely.
Friendly service with Robert!
Everybody at Bond vet is so caring and professional. Robert at the front desk is amazing and Doctor Kaufman is thorough and a total pro. I feel my pets are in the bets hands at Bond.
Took great care of my cat and super easy to make appointments

My first time going to Bond Vet for my dog, who had been suffering from what looked like an ear infection, and I was honestly pretty nervous. But the moment I walked in, everyone greeted me warmly and made me feel comfortable right away.
The entire staff was friendly, introduced themselves, and were very attentive to my dog, Cuba. I really appreciated how understanding they were when I mentioned I had a budget—they truly worked with me and made me feel supported instead of stressed.
I’m so thankful for their kindness and care. They did a great job treating my dog while respecting my financial situation. I would definitely recommend them and will be returning in a heartbeat!
Great care and very patient with all my questions! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a friendly and warm vet!

Bond Vet saved our cat’s life. Seriously.

We took our cat to a different clinic in the area after some strange behavior. They insisted she was ok and that they did some routine things to be safe. After a few hours our cat was clearly in distress and we took them back to the same clinic where they rushed us in and out after an abscess burst.

We were still not satisfied with the care and rushed her to bond where she was seen by Dr.Lucy Howard. The thoroughness of the care our cat received afterwards cannot be understated. She walked us through her entire care process with us in the room, allowed us to stay and try to comfort our cat, and took us through all of the steps for proper care to allow the wound to actually heal. It was a tough adventure, but I truly regret not bringing our cat to bond in the first place after we saw the difference in care. Thank you so much Dr. Howard!

I brought my foster puppy in for a same-day walk-in visit and had a great experience. It was my first time at this facility, and I was seen quickly. The staff was very kind and welcoming.
Quisha was especially gentle, caring, and sweet with my puppy, which I really appreciated. You can tell she truly cares about the animals she works with. Overall, it was a very positive first visit and I’m grateful for the great care my foster puppy received.

Perhaps because I am not white, I experienced strange and unsettling behavior when I took my dog there for the first time on March 4, 2026. I was not greeted upon arrival, and I did not learn the names of anyone who assisted me. I initially had a promotional code for first-time visitors, but because I arrived about 30 minutes late, I was told it could no longer be applied. I was late because Cory called approximately 30 minutes before my appointment, and the call lasted an additional 15–20 minutes. I assumed the code might still be honored given the circumstances, but it was not.

Both Cory and the other front desk employee, a younger woman, were off-putting during the interaction, especially the woman. She frowned the entire time while checking me in and did not appear welcoming. Meanwhile, white customers received smiles and friendly interactions, including attention toward their dogs. This contrast made the environment feel unwelcoming, particularly as a Black person.

I was already anxious because I was worried about my dog’s health. When we were taken to the exam room, the assistant, whose name I was also never given, appeared similarly displeased and did not greet me. I even mentioned that I was feeling uncomfortable. Instead of addressing my concern, she immediately asked whether I knew there would be a fee.

When the doctor entered, he asked the same question. The interaction initially felt just as strange as the others. The only positive aspect of the visit was that he was friendly toward my dog, and my dog seemed to respond well to him.

Overall, it is difficult to fully express how eerie the entire experience felt. I left feeling extremely uncomfortable, as though I had stepped into an environment where I was not welcome. The encounter was deeply unsettling and shocking to me. It is the first time I have personally experienced what felt like such blatant discrimination. It literally felt as if it was the 1800's in a "whites only" establishment.

Needless to say, my dog and I will not be returning.

. I have never experienced something so distressing and unacceptable. We called ahead regarding our dog’s emergency and were directed to this location. We confirmed our estimated arrival time and were explicitly told that someone would be there to assist us.

Their posted Saturday hours are 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. We were given a 7:30 PM time and informed them that we were driving from Manhattan and would arrive by 7:45 PM. We were assured that this would be fine and that staff would be available.

Despite these assurances, when we arrived, we were not allowed inside and were turned away. I was left standing outside in the cold during a pet emergency. The way we were treated felt discriminatory, dismissive, and completely lacking in compassion.

It is deeply troubling that while the phone communication was reassuring, there was absolutely no follow through when we arrived. Sweet words mean nothing without action. In medical situations, especially emergencies, professionalism, accountability, and basic human decency are non negotiable.

This experience raises serious concerns about the standards of care and responsibility expected of a licensed veterinary facility. Both pets and their owners deserve respect, transparency, and humane treatment. What we experienced was the opposite.

If negative zero stars were an option, that is what I would give. I am only giving one star because the system requires it in order to post this review and share what happened.
Beware - prices are 2x to 3x higher than other vets. Did a line by line comparison on invoice vs previous vet in another park of Brooklyn.
Always available and thorough, especially love seeing Dr. Mackey.

My review is general for the whole of Bond Vet, tagged to this location as this was our primary location for services.

Overall, the care is mediocre and doesn't stack up to the cost. Across the 3 years my dog has been a patient, everything comes with a high price. We mostly stayed for the duration as the location was convenient and then my dog unexpectedly needed surgery and we didn't have time to hunt for another provider.

The final straw was how the finances were handled for her surgery. I was excited to hear about Care Credit as an option for a standard surgery that the vet quoted me $7,000 for. To further assist with cost, the staff assured me that I'd have a 2-year interest free period with this option. After 6 months, I was charged interest on this credit and I immediately reached out both to the third party bank and Bond. After an initial call and follow-up with Bond, I waited ~3 months with no word and gave in, reaching out again to address the matter.
This ultimately resulted in Bond not covering for their error and leaving me to absorb the $1,000 interest that has accumulated on the account, which is under my name so leaving me no choice but to pay. The bank noted that had the issue been addressed sooner, there would have been other options to recoup the accrued interest - to which the vet's response was, next time there's an issue, I should do a better job hounding and staying on top of the staff so resolution can be found quickly.
Appalled and extremely upset about how this was handled is understatement, even the mere thought still has the power to ruin my day.
On a personal level, there are sacrifices and hardships that come with taking on a $1,000 expense that wasn't expected and budgeted for. I am now holding the burden of figuring out what adjustments I need to make to ensure this doesn't snowball to an even larger burden for myself.

My glass half full is my dog and I will be separating from the Bond Vet, which is long overdue.
Hoping that there are options out there that are providing services at a level that cares for the community and mirrors what they are asking to be compensated.

I am beyond grateful for Bond Vet Cobble Hill and especially Dr. Erin Mackey. I originally brought my cat Sophie in because she had blood in her stool and what we thought was a simple issue turned into something much more serious. Sophie was pregnant and after Dr. Mackey recommended an ultrasound and X ray she discovered a fractured pelvis that a previous vet completely missed.
Dr. Mackey truly saved my cat’s life. Her attention to detail her urgency and her compassion made all the difference. The entire Cobble Hill staff was just as incredible. Everyone was kind patient and genuinely caring from start to finish. You can feel how much they truly love animals 🐾💙
Yes Bond Vet is a little bit on the pricier side compared to others, but it is absolutely worth every dollar. I have gone back to Bond Vet Cobble Hill and I will continue to go back no matter what. Also I highly recommend pet insurance. I have Spot Pet Insurance and it helped me so much.

If you are looking for a vet who truly listens and goes above and beyond this is the place. Dr. Mackey is the best and I will forever be thankful to Bond Vet for saving my girl 🥹✨

Bond vet is good for routine check ups and vaccines, they always have lots of availability. But they are not good for pets with serious health issues. They refused to diagnose our kitten with FIP despite him showing lots of symptoms and showing lots of markers in his bloodwork. They didnt take his case seriously, as his health deteriorated very fast. We were able to save our kittens life by seeking treatment elsewhere. FIP Warriors on Facebook will help if you have the bloodwork to prove your cat has FIP.
Dr. K and the whole team are great!

I called ahead to say my uber was delayed and would be 15 min late. I was informed of the 15 min grace period and would be moved to a walk in if I was more than 15 min late. I was offered the option to reschedule for a $25 fee and I declined as I believed I would make it in time. 5 minutes later, I received a text saying I would be charged $155 walk in fee if I arrived past the 15 min grace period.  I arrived 1 minute past the grace period and was told I would have to wait several hours as a walk in. There weren’t any questions asked about my pet nor was I asked how I would like to proceed. I mentioned that the lack of compassion and eagerness to repeatedly mention the policies is why there are mixed reviews about Bond Vet. She walked away from me and never checked back in. I stood at the desk for 7 min while I booked another appointment at another location and requested my uber. She never came back to follow up. Once I left, I received another text saying I would need to reschedule as I’m more than half way through my appointment. I’m very disappointed with the customer service I received at cobble hill and will not be returning.

I had a terrible and deeply concerning experience with Daniel Bloomfield (I wouldn't call this one a Dr) at this clinic, and despite the medical director reaching out afterward, I never received any follow-up or accountability regarding his behavior.

On September 27, 2024, my dog Boomer was in severe, unexplained pain — crying and screaming. This was our first stop due to the urgency. Daniel Bloomfield was late, cold, and impatient, and repeatedly dismissed my basic follow-up questions (when I only asked 1-2 questions regarding the cause and treatment). Instead of explaining my dog’s condition clearly, he responded in a condescending and arrogant manner (including remarks like, “Do you not watch the news?”).

When I asked one additional question, he cut me off, said he was late for his next appointment, and implied that treatment could be withheld if I continued asking questions, saying, “If you don’t like it, we don’t have to give the pain medication.” Ultimately, no meaningful treatment was provided, and we left while my dog was still in severe pain.

In the hours and days that followed, I visited around 3 other veterinary clinics, including my regular vet and the specialty hospital BluePearl, AMC. Every other team was compassionate, thorough, and focused on reducing my dog’s pain and guiding us to the appropriate next steps. This made it clear that what we experienced here was not normal or acceptable veterinary care.

A single provider Daniel Bloomfield with his attitude creates a toxic and unsafe environment for both pets and pet owners - and the lack of follow-up from leadership only reinforces that this clinic tolerates behavior that no one in crisis should ever be subjected to. So, taking your pets elsewhere.

Brought my senior cat in for an illness visit. He was vomiting all weekend. I was hoping it would pass because I was concerned about affordability of treatment. I arrived 15mins early and waited for about 30mins to see our nurse. Later, the vets came in and gave him a check up. They asked questions and answered all of mine as well with no rush. In the end, I paid $260 for treatment and they gave me a couple complimentary services as well. It was such a relief and they really do care. Thank you BondVet ❤️
